Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! River Plate 1, Lanús 0. Thiago Almada (River Plate) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Goal! River Plate 1, Lanús 1. Ramiro Carrera (Lanús) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Agustín Medina.
Thiago Almada (River Plate) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Felipe Peña Biafore (Lanús) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, River Plate 1, Lanús 1.
Substitution, River Plate. Francisco Ortega replaces Marcos Acuña.
Substitution, River Plate. Sebastián Driussi replaces Lucas Beltrán because of an injury.
Marcelino Moreno (Lanús) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! River Plate 2, Lanús 1. Tobías Andrada (River Plate) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Lanús. Yoshan Valois replaces Ramiro Carrera.
Substitution, Lanús. Lucas Besozzi replaces Allan Wlk.
Sebastián Driussi (River Plate) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Santiago Espíndola (River Plate) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
